svg.text: 1. Power every kit module from 3.3 V. No external resistors are used.
2. Join the GND of the FRDM-MCXC444 and the ESP32 (common ground).
3. MCX_3V3 = FRDM-MCXC444 3V3 pin. ESP_3V3 = ESP32 3V3 pin.
4. Small numbers next to U1 pins are FRDM header positions (e.g. J4-2).
5. Segment LCD (DS1) is on the FRDM board: no wiring; keep JP7 shorted.
6. X = not connected. MPU-6050 AD0 left open (I2C address 0x68).
7. ESP32-S2 Mini USB-C goes to the laptop: it powers the board and acts as the keyboard.
